english_draft:
Amazon issued its first-quarter results for the quarter ended March 31, 2026 on April 29, 2026.
Net sales were $181.5 billion in the first quarter.
Net sales increased 17% year over year.
Excluding a $2.9 billion favorable impact from year-over-year changes in foreign exchange rates, net sales increased 15%.
North America segment sales increased 12% to $104.1 billion.
International segment sales increased 19% to $39.8 billion.
Excluding foreign exchange changes, International segment sales increased 11%.
AWS segment sales increased 28% to $37.6 billion.
Operating income was $23.9 billion in the first quarter, compared with $18.4 billion in the first quarter of 2025.
North America segment operating income was $8.3 billion.
International segment operating income was $1.4 billion.
AWS segment operating income was $14.2 billion.
Net income was $30.3 billion, or $2.78 per diluted share.
Net income was $17.1 billion, or $1.59 per diluted share, in the first quarter of 2025.
Net income included $16.8 billion of pre-tax gains in non-operating income from Amazon's investments in Anthropic.
Operating income did not include these gains.
Operating cash flow for the trailing twelve months was $148.5 billion, up 30% year over year.
Free cash flow for the trailing twelve months was $1.2 billion, down from $25.9 billion in the prior year period.
The decrease primarily reflected a $59.3 billion increase in purchases of property and equipment, net of proceeds from sales and incentives.
Management said this increase mainly reflected investments in artificial intelligence.
Management also said AWS grew 28%, its fastest growth in 15 quarters.
The chips business exceeded a $20 billion annual revenue run rate and grew triple digits year over year.
Advertising exceeded $70 billion in trailing twelve-month revenue.
Store unit growth reached 15%.
No same-period Preview existed before this report.
This analysis does not create a retrospective forecast.
reader_questions: 营业利润239亿美元是否完全不含Anthropic投资收益，而净利润中的168亿美元是否全部计入非营业收入？
AWS 28%的增速中有多少来自OpenAI、Anthropic等多年期算力承诺，这些承诺何时开始计入收入和现金流？
自由现金流由259亿美元降至12亿美元，是否意味着2026年后续季度可能因AI资本开支继续承压甚至转负？
fact_checks: 来源与日期：官方新闻稿标题《Amazon.com Announces First Quarter Results》，发布日期2026-04-29，对应截至2026-03-31的季度。
营收：净销售额1815亿美元、同比+17%；剔除汇率后+15%；北美1041亿美元(+12%)；国际398亿美元(+19%，剔除汇率+11%)；AWS376亿美元(+28%)。
利润：营业利润239亿美元（上年同期184亿）；北美83亿、国际14亿、AWS142亿；净利润303亿美元、摊薄EPS 2.78美元；上年同期净利润171亿美元、EPS 1.59美元。
非营业项目：净利润含Anthropic投资税前收益168亿美元，计入非营业收入；营业利润不含该收益。
现金流：TTM经营现金流1485亿美元(+30%)；TTM自由现金流12亿美元，上年同期259亿美元；自由现金流下降主要因物业及设备采购净额同比增加593亿美元，管理层称主要投向AI。
管理层声明：AWS增速28%为15个季度最快；芯片年化收入运行率超200亿美元且同比三位数增长；广告TTM收入超700亿美元；零售单位销量增速达15%。
Preview：来源未附财报前同期Preview，也未附公司指引或可靠卖方共识；本文不事后补写预测，不推断业绩符合或超出预期。
